sn34.8:1.4: Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī || || 5
sn34.8:1.5: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo || || 6
sn34.8:1.6: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī || || 7
sn34.8:1.7: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca || || 8
sn34.8:1.8: Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca || ayam imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhayīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca || || 9
